spots.name: Untitled graffiti
spots.blurb: You're at a graffiti piece that has been mapped here. Street art changes fast, so if the wall has been repainted, look around: the next piece is often close by.

spots.name: Union Block Mural
spots.blurb: You've reached Union Block Mural, a mural by J. Maizlish Mole. White, filled outline of the United States on a black background, with a red asterisk marking Hastings, MI.
